# Vendored dependency

`p5.min.js` is the unmodified p5.js 1.9.0 browser distribution.

- Project: https://github.com/processing/p5.js/tree/v1.9.0
- Distribution source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.9.0/p5.min.js
- SHA-256: `726AC96626B93F5BCAFF83A910B6C60D3A9728F063E0EB73B5D0819FFC356915`
- p5.js license: GNU LGPL 2.1; see `p5.LICENSE.txt`
- Bundled dependency notices: see `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`

The local copy keeps the artwork operational without a third-party runtime request. When upgrading, replace the distribution, license, and dependency notices, update the recorded hashes and cache revision, then run `node scripts/validate.mjs`.
